{{Quote|What's that?''"<br />"''Spice.|Alema Rar and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''Orchid-bean extract''' was a spice additive that could be used with [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]].<ref name="JK" />

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] made the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alema Rar]] a cup of hot chocolate aboard her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''. Leia added a sliver of [[tangbark]] and a drop of orchid-bean extract to the cup as flavoring.<ref name="JK" />
